meaning_hint: Slang, mostly the exclamation Респект! (props); the neutral word is повага.
examples: I have a lot of respect for my teacher.
Show some respect to older people.
He earned the team's respect.
Treat everyone with respect.
I use my laptop for work and school.
She forgot her laptop at the café.
My laptop battery lasts eight hours.
He bought a new laptop yesterday.
A policeman helped me find my way.
The policeman stopped the traffic.
My uncle is a policeman.
The policeman asked to see my license.
note: "Police officer" is more common and neutral.

meaning_hint: Also any small meal eaten between main meals.
examples: I had a small snack before dinner.
Nuts are a healthy snack.
Kids want snacks after school.
Let's buy some snacks for the movie.
The doctor examined the boy's penis.
The penis is part of the male body.
The biology book has a chapter on the penis.
He saw a doctor about pain in his penis.
There is a conflict between the two groups.
The conflict lasted for many years.
We try to avoid conflict at work.
They solved the conflict by talking.
Cats hunt by instinct.
My first instinct was to run.
Trust your instincts in this situation.
Birds know where to fly by instinct.

meaning_hint: Also colloquially a bank card, like English.
examples: This toy is made of plastic.
Plastic is bad for the ocean.
We try to use less plastic.
Put the plastic in the blue bin.
I'd like my steak medium rare, please.
He grilled steaks for dinner.
This restaurant serves the best steak in town.
We had steak and potatoes last night.
Add a slice of lemon to my tea.
Squeeze the lemon over the fish.
These lemons are very sour.
She made lemon cake for dessert.
Morning coffee is my favorite ritual.

Lighting candles is part of the ritual.

The farm is about fifty acres.

The park covers two hundred acres.
One acre is a little smaller than a soccer field.
I wrote the meeting on my calendar.
Check your calendar for next week.
She has a cat calendar on the wall.
My calendar is full this month.
Gambling is illegal in some states.
He lost all his money on gambling.
The city has many gambling halls.
Online gambling is growing very fast.
The doctor used a laser to fix her eyes.
The cat chases the laser on the floor.
A laser cuts the metal.
The laser printer is in the office.

meaning_hint: Mountain peak or highest point; час пік = rush hour.
examples: We reached the peak by noon.
Snow covers the mountain peaks.
The view from the peak is amazing.
He climbed the highest peak.
The whole town came out for the parade.
Soldiers marched in the parade on Independence Day.
We watched the parade from our balcony.
Kids love the floats in the holiday parade.
What are the ingredients in this cake?
Fresh ingredients make better food.
Flour is the main ingredient.
She bought all the ingredients for dinner.

meaning_hint: Literary genre.
examples: She likes reading fiction more than history books.
This story is pure fiction.
He writes science fiction for young readers.
The fiction section is on the second floor.
note: Uncountable: a work of fiction, not "a fiction".

examples: The lock has a simple mechanism inside.
The clock's mechanism stopped working.
Engineers checked the mechanism of the door.
This toy uses a spring mechanism.
The plane disappeared from the radar.
Police use radar to catch fast drivers.
The ship's radar showed another boat nearby.
Weather radar shows rain moving toward the city.

meaning_hint: Internet slang: laughing out loud.
examples: LOL, that is funny!
LOL, me too.
LOL, I love it!
LOL, good one!
note: Used in chats and texts. It means "laughing out loud".

meaning_hint: Cosmetic cream or pastry cream; dairy cream = вершки
examples: I put some cream on my dry hands.
Do you want cream in your coffee?
This cream helps with sunburn.
Strawberries with cream are my favorite.
She is the founder of the company.
The founder started the shop in 2010.
I met the founder at a meeting.
The founders were two young friends.
The ship carried cargo across the ocean.
The plane was full of cargo.
Workers unloaded the cargo at the port.
They ship cargo by train and truck.

meaning_hint: In Ukrainian also a prefix: аудіокнига = audiobook.
examples: The audio is too quiet.
I can't hear the audio on the video.
Check your audio before the call.
I listen to audio books in the car.

meaning_hint: Indeclinable; also spelled есей.
examples: I have to write an essay for my English class.
Her essay won first prize.
The essay is due on Monday.
He wrote a short essay about his family.
She comes from a large Scottish clan.
The whole clan came to the family reunion.
Each clan had its own leader.
Our clan meets every year for a barbecue.
The light turns on when the sensor sees movement.
My phone has a fingerprint sensor.
The car has parking sensors in the back.
A sensor measures the temperature in the room.

meaning_hint: social gender only; grammatical gender = рід; also spelled ґендер
examples: Please write your name, age, and gender.
What is the gender of your baby?
Jobs should be open to every gender.
The form asks about your gender.
The DJ played music all night.
We hired a DJ for the wedding.
He works as a DJ at a club.
The DJ took song requests from the crowd.
She lives a healthy lifestyle.
Moving to the city changed his lifestyle.
The magazine writes about fashion and lifestyle.
A busy lifestyle can cause stress.
I had bacon and eggs for breakfast.
The bacon is too crispy.
Add some bacon to the salad.
The kitchen smells like bacon.

meaning_hint: Noun: the original (document, artwork); the adjective is оригінальний.
examples: This painting is the original, not a copy.
The original is kept in a museum.
I read the book in the original.
Keep the original and send a copy.

meaning_hint: депозит is a bank deposit; a down payment is завдаток, a mineral deposit is родовище.
examples: I made a deposit at the bank.
You need a deposit to rent the apartment.
The deposit is one month's rent.
We got our deposit back.
The nurse checked my pulse.
His pulse was very fast.
You can feel your pulse on your wrist.
Her pulse slowed down after the run.
This store only sells high-end phones and laptops.
A high-end camera is too expensive for me.
We stayed in a high-end hotel near the beach.
He wants a high-end computer for video editing.
The admiral commanded the whole fleet.
He was promoted to admiral last year.
The admiral visited the sailors on the ship.
An admiral is a very high navy rank.
Let's meet at the cafe on the corner.
She works part-time in a cafe.
This cafe has great cakes.
We had breakfast at a small cafe.

meaning_hint: Usually written Mr (Mr Smith); містер is used for English-speaking men.
examples: Excuse me, mister, you dropped your wallet.
Hey, mister, can you help us?
The kids called him Mister Smith.
Thank you, mister, have a nice day.
note: Usually written "Mr." before a name; "mister" alone is informal.

meaning_hint: Only money capital; a capital city is столиця, a capital letter is велика літера.
examples: They need more capital to start the business.
He used his own capital for the shop.
The company raised capital from investors.
Starting a business takes capital.

meaning_hint: A new album, film or software release; also прес-реліз (press release). Release from prison is звільнення.
examples: The band's new release is out today.
The movie has a summer release.
The game's release was delayed again.
Fans waited a long time for the release.

meaning_hint: Only a public image (reputation, style); a picture is зображення.
examples: The company wants a better public image.
He works hard on his image.
The star changed her image last year.
A clean image matters in business.
This song has a great rhythm.
Clap your hands to the rhythm.
He has no sense of rhythm.
The drummer keeps the rhythm.

meaning_hint: English workshop also means a workroom (майстерня).
examples: I signed up for a writing workshop.
The workshop lasts two days.
She led a workshop on public speaking.
We learned a lot at the workshop.

meaning_hint: Only a person (tour guide); a guidebook is путівник.
examples: Our tour guide spoke three languages.
The guide showed us the old part of town.
We hired a local guide for the mountain hike.
The museum guide answered all our questions.

meaning_hint: Noun only (breakdown of a system, medical collapse); a building collapse = обвал, to collapse = обвалюватися
examples: The bank's collapse shocked everyone.
The economy is close to collapse.
The collapse of the bridge killed three people.
After the collapse, many people lost their jobs.
My parents were immigrants.
Many immigrants live in this city.
She helps new immigrants find work.
He came here as an immigrant.

meaning_hint: канал also means a TV channel; in English that is a channel
examples: Boats travel along the canal.
We walked along the old canal.
The Panama Canal connects two oceans.
The city has many canals and bridges.

meaning_hint: кілер usually means a hired killer (hitman); a killer in general is вбивця.
examples: The killer was caught by the police.
Police are looking for the killer.
He was hired as a killer.
The killer left no clues.
People called him a freak at school.
She's a total fitness freak.
He's a control freak at work.
They looked at me like I was a freak.
note: Informal and can be rude; "freak" also means a big fan: a health freak.

meaning_hint: mainly in political/media language (політична агенда); a meeting agenda = порядок денний
examples: The president has a clear political agenda.
Health care is high on the agenda.
He has a hidden agenda.
The party pushed its agenda in parliament.
note: Also means a list of topics for a meeting.

examples: They live in luxury in a big villa.
A new car is a luxury we can't afford.
The hotel offers comfort and luxury.
She enjoys small luxuries like hot baths.
We ordered two cocktails at the bar.
This cocktail has lime and mint.
They served cocktails before dinner.
What is your favorite cocktail?
Heh, that's a funny joke.
Heh, I didn't think you'd notice.
He just said "heh" and smiled.
Heh, nice try.
note: Informal, mostly in writing and chat.

examples: My uncle is a successful businessman.
The businessman flew to New York for a meeting.
A local businessman opened three new cafes.
He wants to become a businessman like his father.
Put the leftovers in a plastic container.
The ship carries hundreds of containers.
Store the cookies in an airtight container.
The container is full of water.
The concert is at the downtown arena.
The arena holds twenty thousand fans.
They built a new hockey arena.
Fans filled the arena before the game.
The officer carried a pistol on his belt.
